optimized_sql:
select i_item_id, avg(ss_quantity) agg1, avg(ss_list_price) agg2, avg(ss_coupon_amt) agg3, avg(ss_sales_price) agg4 
from store_sales 
join customer_demographics on ss_cdemo_sk = cd_demo_sk and cd_gender = 'F' and cd_marital_status = 'W' and cd_education_status = 'College'
join item on ss_item_sk = i_item_sk
join promotion on ss_promo_sk = p_promo_sk and (p_channel_email = 'N' or p_channel_event = 'N')
where ss_sold_date_sk in (select d_date_sk from date_dim where d_year = 2001)
group by i_item_id 
order by i_item_id 
limit 100
